data.name: Ansha
data.gender_notes: Ansha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ansha means 'a light' or 'a helper'. It is derived from the root 'ansh', meaning 'to support'. The name is often used for girls, reflecting the belief in the light of guidance and support that Allah (SWT) provides. The name Ansha carries the meaning “A light, a helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ansha usually hope their child will grow to embody a light, a helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the light of Allah's guidance
data.etymology: Ansha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A light, a helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
